finding: Within the captured windows, the 2027-02-15 → 2027-02-22 stay is the cheapest at $922 total, $518 less than the 2027-03-15 → 2027-03-22 window for the identical room. Late February and March pricing rises steadily. This contradicts the usual 'shoulder season is cheaper' intuition and is the single most actionable pricing finding in this study.
